newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.004 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.004 mln gallons.

text.p: Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended October 5 was 4,004,866 gallons compared with 5,100,274 gallons last week.
Imports were 708,457 gallons compared with 202,914 gallons the previous week, and domestic receipts totaled 59,613 gallons versus 35,851 gallons a week ago.
Retail movement was 945,123 gallons compared with 1,022,663 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 2,609,887 gallons versus 4,159,373 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 230,200,697 versus 231,703,185 a year ago.
Inventory was 67,277,707 versus 76,442,965 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 boxes compared with 216,502,392 boxes a year ago.
